## 7c. Non-token cost per fact (H150, 160 facts): tool executions and LLM calls

Guard tool executions = observations the policy's check replays or hashes per read, summed over reads (`guard_io`: evidence queries for ESM / REPLAY, read-set files for FILEHASH / ASTHASH / LLMDIFF, citations for CITE, certificate calls for CERT-*). Re-derivation tool calls / LLM calls = the recorded agent traces of the re-derivations the policy triggered. Serial LLM time = calls × median per-call latency in the ledger (27B, measured with 2–4 requests in flight per GPU: judge 21.5 s, derivation turn 22.2 s) — an indicative estimate, not a wall-clock measurement. Certificate construction calls are not included.
